title: DB mutex lock uses .unwrap(), panicking on a poisoned lock
evidence: src/lib.rs:138,151,171,181,193 — `db.lock().unwrap()`; if any handler panics while holding the lock, subsequent requests panic instead of returning a 500
suggestion: Map the PoisonError to ApiError::Internal so a poisoned lock degrades to a JSON 500 rather than crashing the handler task
